sections.content: Describe a problem precisely with expressions such as hay, se produce, se ha producido and tener problemas con. Add a relative clause or consequence to explain what the problem affects.

items.spanish: Se ha producido una avería que afecta a todo el edificio.
items.english: A breakdown has occurred that affects the whole building.

items.spanish: Hay un atasco que impide que los autobuses lleguen a tiempo.
items.english: There is a traffic jam that prevents buses from arriving on time.

items.spanish: El fallo afecta a un servicio del que dependen muchas personas.
items.english: The fault affects a service on which many people depend.

items.spanish: Tenemos un obstáculo que dificulta la solución.
items.english: We have an obstacle that makes the solution difficult.

sections.content: Describe what is wrong, what it affects and why it matters.
